title: GLiDE: A Fast, Calibrated Decision Model Distilled from Reasoning Teachers
abstract: arXiv:2611.26509v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision models enable fast, confidence-aware decisions by scoring candidate answers in a single forward pass, without generating text or intermediate reasoning. Yet reasoning can substantially improve decision quality, raising the question of whether its benefits can be retained without the cost of generating it. We investigate this question with \textbf{GLiDE}, a family of decision models spanning 0.4B to 27B parameters.   Building on Qwen hybrid language models, GLiDE enables bidirectional interactions between the context, question, and candidate answers by removing causal masking from full-attention layers. To transfer reasoning capabilities into single-pass inference, we combine soft-target distillation from multiple teachers, including a reasoning model, with progressive post-training on diverse decision tasks. We further explore parameter-free recurrent depth to increase inference-time computation without generating tokens.   Acro

translated_title: GLiDE：从推理教师模型蒸馏得到的快速校准决策模型
translated_abstract: 决策模型通过在单次前向传播中对候选答案进行评分，实现快速且具备置信度感知的决策，而无需生成文本或中间推理过程。然而，推理能够显著提升决策质量，这引发了一个问题：能否在不付出生成推理的代价的情况下保留推理带来的收益。我们通过 GLiDE 来研究这一问题，GLiDE 是一系列参数规模从 0.4B 到 27B 的决策模型。GLiDE 基于 Qwen 混合语言模型构建，通过移除全注意力层中的因果掩码，实现了上下文、问题和候选答案之间的双向交互。为了将推理能力迁移到单次推理中，我们将来自多个教师模型（包括一个推理模型）的软目标蒸馏与在多样化决策任务上的渐进式后训练相结合。我们还进一步探索了无参数的循环深度，以在不生成 token 的情况下增加推理时的计算量。
tldr: GLiDE 通过多教师软目标蒸馏、双向注意力机制和无参数循环深度，将推理教师模型的能力迁移到单次前向传播即可完成的决策模型中，在无需生成推理文本的情况下保留了推理带来的决策质量提升。
en_tdlr: GLiDE transfers reasoning capabilities from teacher models into fast decision models that score candidate answers in a single forward pass, combining multi-teacher soft-target distillation, bidirectional attention, and parameter-free recurrent depth to retain the benefits of reasoning without generating reasoning text.
